item.description:
标签: #AI智能体 #Claude #代码生成

摘要: 本文介绍了Claude 4.6的重大更新（包括百万token上下文和四种自动化工作模式）、Anthropic针对长时应用开发的多智能体架构设计，以及AI代理时代将终结应用商店垄断、转向开放API生态的趋势。

原标题: Claude Auto Mode 🤖, ChatGPT product discovery 🛒, long running harnesses 👨‍💻

TLDR AI 2026-03-25

Claude Auto Mode 🤖, ChatGPT product discovery 🛒, long running harnesses 👨‍💻

Crusoe BYOM: 5x Higher Throughput for Custom Models (Sponsor)

You've built the perfect fine-tuned model. Now scale it without compromise. Generic cloud infrastructure wasn't designed for proprietary architectures, leading to performance bottlenecks. Crusoe's Bring Your Own Model (BYOM) changes that. Powered by MemoryAlloy™ technology, Crusoe optimizes its inference engine specifically for your unique weights.

您已经构建了完美的微调模型。现在无需妥协即可扩展它。通用云基础设施并非为专有架构设计，导致性能瓶颈。Crusoe 的 BYOM（Bring Your Own Model，自带模型） 改变了这一点。借助 MemoryAlloy™ 技术，Crusoe 专门针对您独特的权重优化其推理引擎。

The result? 5x higher throughput and breakthrough Time-To-First-Token speed compared to stock vLLM. Maintain total IP ownership with dedicated capacity and "glass box" visibility. Stop letting infrastructure hold back your AI innovation and start scaling with precision.

结果是？与原生 vLLM 相比，吞吐量提高5倍，Time-To-First-Token（首Token时间） 速度实现突破。通过专用容量和"玻璃盒"可见性，保持对 IP（知识产权） 的完全所有权。不要让基础设施阻碍您的 AI 创新，开始精确扩展。

Optimize your workload now

立即优化您的工作负载

App Store | Age of Agent (6 minute read)

The App Store was a centralized answer to the distribution problem of a new computing platform. The agent era will need a new solution as agents need APIs, not app stores. Apple gained its revenue by forcing every in-app transaction through its payment system. The agent era lacks Apple's lock-in mechanics, so if one platform tries to charge high payment fees, users will just switch to a competitor. This suggests the payment layer will be competitive and low-margin rather than monopolistic.

App Store（应用商店） 是对新计算平台分发问题的集中式解决方案。随着智能体需要 API（应用程序接口） 而非应用商店，智能体时代将需要新的解决方案。Apple（苹果） 通过强制每笔应用内交易经由其支付系统来获得收入。智能体时代缺乏苹果的锁定机制，因此如果某个平台试图收取高额支付费用，用户只会转向竞争对手。这表明支付层将具有竞争性和低利润特性，而非垄断性。

Harness design for long-running application development (24 minute read)

Anthropic's Prithvi Rajasekaran developed a multi-agent architecture to improve AI-driven frontend design and full-stack application coding, addressing issues of coherence and self-evaluation. Inspired by GANs, this approach uses planner, generator, and evaluator agents to produce complex, high-quality outputs by decomposing tasks and utilizing structured handoffs. Despite improvements, challenges remain in context management and evaluator tuning, highlighting the ongoing need for adapting harness designs as AI models advance.

Anthropic 的 Prithvi Rajasekaran 开发了一种多智能体架构，用于改进 AI 驱动的前端设计和全栈应用编码，解决一致性和自我评估问题。受 GANs（生成对抗网络） 启发，该方法使用规划器、生成器和评估器智能体，通过分解任务和利用结构化交接来产生复杂、高质量的输出。尽管有所改进，但在上下文管理和评估器调优方面仍存在挑战，突显了随着 AI 模型发展而不断调整 harness 设计的持续需求。

Claude 2026: Everything Shipped & How to Use It (15 minute read)

As of March, Claude 4.6 features a 1M token context window and four distinct modes: Chat, Cowork, Code, and Projects. The Cowork suite automates workflows via Scheduled Tasks and Connectors, while the Code environment utilizes CLAUDE.md hierarchy, MCP protocols, and Agent Teams for autonomous development. Key upgrades include Computer Use research previews and deterministic Hooks for programmable guardrails.

截至3月，Claude 4.6 具备100万 token 的上下文窗口和四种不同模式：聊天、Cowork（协作）、代码和项目。Cowork 套件通过 Scheduled Tasks（定时任务） 和 Connectors（连接器） 实现工作流自动化，而代码环境则利用 CLAUDE.md 层级、MCP（模型上下文协议） 和 Agent Teams（智能体团队） 进行自主开发。关键升级包括 Computer Use（计算机使用） 研究预览版，以及用于可编程护栏的确定性 Hooks（钩子）。

RLVR's Impact on Reasoning Performance (18 minute read)

Directional updates in RLVR were shown to better identify reasoning-critical tokens, enabling both test-time extrapolation and training-time reweighting to boost accuracy.

RLVR（Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards，基于可验证奖励的强化学习） 中的定向更新被证明能更好地识别对推理至关重要的 token，从而实现测试时外推和训练时重加权，以提高准确性。

Trained on Tokens, Calibrated on Concepts: The Emergence of Semantic Calibration in LLMs (3 minute read)

Semantic calibration appears to emerge as a byproduct of next-token prediction. Base models are remarkably well-calibrated when using a certain sampling-based notion of semantic calibration. They can meaningfully assess confidence in open-domain question-answering tasks despite not being explicitly trained to do so.

Semantic calibration（语义校准） 似乎作为 next-token prediction（下一 token 预测） 的副产品而出现。当使用基于采样的特定语义校准概念时，基础模型表现出显著的校准性能。尽管没有接受明确训练，它们仍能在开放域问答任务中有意义地评估置信度。

Introducing Ossature: Spec-Driven Code Generation (11 minute read)

Ossature is an open-source harness for spec-driven code generation. Developers write specifications describing what their software should do, and Ossature validates them, has an LLM audit them for ambiguities and gaps, produces an editable plan, and then generates code one task at a time. Each task only gets the context it needs. Ossature has verification built into the build loop. If verification fails, a fixer agent gets the error output and tries to repair the code.

Ossature 是一个用于 spec-driven（规范驱动） 代码生成的开源 harness。开发者编写描述软件功能的规范，Ossature 对其进行验证，让 LLM（大语言模型） 审计其中的歧义和缺口，生成可编辑的计划，然后逐个任务生成代码。每个任务仅获取其所需的上下文。Ossature 将验证内置于构建循环中。如果验证失败，修复智能体会获取错误输出并尝试修复代码。

Ray Data LLM enables 2x throughput over vLLM's synchronous LLM engine at production-scale (12 minute read)

Many of the modern workloads that LLMs are increasingly utilized for prioritize throughput over per-request latency, which many LLM systems and deployments optimize for today. Ray Data LLM is a library built for large-scale batch inference for LLMs. It provides scalable execution, high throughput, and fault tolerance. It has a highly optimized architecture for running LLM batch inference. Users can achieve 2x throughput with Ray Data LLM over vLLM's synchronous LLM engine while benefiting from production-scale resiliency.

许多现代 LLM（大语言模型） 工作负载越来越优先关注 throughput（吞吐量） 而非每请求的 latency（延迟），而这是当今许多 LLM 系统和部署所优化的方向。Ray Data LLM 是一个为 LLM 大规模批处理推理构建的库。它提供可扩展的执行、高吞吐量和容错能力。它拥有高度优化的架构来运行 LLM 批处理推理。与 vLLM 的同步 LLM 引擎相比，用户可以使用 Ray Data LLM 实现2倍的吞吐量，同时受益于生产规模的弹性。

Google's Extreme Vector Compression (5 minute read)

TurboQuant is a quantization method that reduces vector memory overhead while preserving performance. This improves key-value cache efficiency and accelerates vector search.

TurboQuant 是一种 quantization（量化） 方法，在保持性能的同时减少向量内存开销。这提高了 key-value cache（键值缓存） 效率并加速向量搜索。

US Government's Ban on Anthropic Looks Like Punishment, Judge Says (6 minute read)

US District Judge Rita F. Lin of the Northern District of California said during a court hearing that the US government appeared to be punishing Anthropic by banning the company. The hearing is part of Anthropic's efforts to ease the government ban on the use of the company's AI models. Lin has yet to rule on the matter but expressed serious doubts about the Trump administration's actions in her opening remarks. The government's action has already cost Anthropic hundreds of millions of dollars in canceled contracts and aborted customer agreements.

加利福尼亚北区联邦地区法官 Rita F. Lin 在法庭听证会上表示，美国政府通过禁止该公司似乎在惩罚 Anthropic。该听证会是 Anthropic 努力缓解政府对其 AI 模型使用禁令的一部分。Lin 尚未对此做出裁决，但在开场陈述中对 Trump administration（特朗普政府） 的行为表示了严重怀疑。政府的行为已经使 Anthropic 因合同取消和客户协议中止而损失了数亿美元。

OpenAI raises additional money to bring record funding round to $120 billion, CFO tells Cramer (5 minute read)

OpenAI has announced a new $10 billion commitment from a16z, DE Shaw Ventures, MGX, TPG, and T Rowe Price. The fresh capital brings OpenAI's record fundraise to over $120 billion. OpenAI has moderated its spending plans and is now targeting approximately $600 billion in total compute spend through 2030. It is now taking steps to prioritize its most profitable initiatives ahead of an IPO.

OpenAI 宣布获得来自 a16z、DE Shaw Ventures、MGX、TPG 和 T Rowe Price 的100亿美元新承诺。这笔新资金使 OpenAI 的创纪录融资额超过1200亿美元。OpenAI 已调整其支出计划，现在目标是到2030年总计约6000亿美元的计算支出。该公司现在正在采取措施，在 IPO（首次公开募股） 之前优先发展其最盈利的项目。

摘要: AI编程工具掀起的"vibe coding"浪潮正冲击苹果等传统应用商店的审查机制与商业模式，迫使软件分发范式向开放网络转移；与此同时，LiteLLM供应链攻击事件与Anthropic智能体架构的突破，折射出AI基础设施在安全性与工程化层面的深层变革。

原标题: [AINews] Apple's War on Slop

[AINews] Apple's War on Slop

There were few bright spots today, as Microsoft AI exec hired AI2 leadership, OpenAI's Sora became the first casualty of the Side Quest massacre (probably Atlas too), and LiteLLM suffered/created a huge supply chain vulnerability for ~all Python AI projects.

今天几乎没有什么好消息，Microsoft AI 高管挖走了 AI2 的领导层，OpenAI 的 Sora 成为"支线项目大屠杀"（Side Quest massacre）的第一个牺牲品（可能还包括 Atlas），而 LiteLLM 遭遇/制造了一个针对几乎所有 Python AI 项目的巨大供应链安全漏洞（supply chain vulnerability）。

All will fade in due time, so do not deserve title story, but today we highlight this chart which tells an ongoing story that ALL traditional app stores like Apple and AI-native app stores like Dreamer face:

所有这些事件终将随时间消逝，因此不值得作为标题故事，但今天我们重点展示这张图表，它讲述了一个持续进行的故事：无论是像 Apple 这样的传统应用商店，还是像 Dreamer 这样的 AI 原生应用商店，都面临着同样的困境。

Even as the debate rages on about AI killing all SaaS, the ability to vibe code apps and hopefully buy a ticket to a >$100M exit as an 18 year old high school dropout means that ~everyone with any entrepreneurial spirit is going to at least try it, and traditional app store review processes will die. This comes even as Apple starts blocking vibe code apps like Replit and Vibecode on policy reasons, and, even though there were legitimately defensible issues, it is clear that the normal app distribution paradigms are completely breaking down in 2026. We declared the War on Slop a key theme for 2026 in Jan, and now this is one of the most important charts in the world for thinking through it's ramifications on the decades-long supremacy of the Apple App Store as well as other similar software distribution platforms vs the open web.

尽管关于 AI 将杀死所有 SaaS 的争论仍在激烈进行，但氛围编程（vibe code，指通过自然语言描述让 AI 生成代码）开发应用的能力，以及作为 18 岁高中辍学生有望获得超 1 亿美元退出的机会，意味着几乎所有具有创业精神的人都将至少尝试一次，而传统的应用商店审核流程将走向消亡。与此同时，Apple 开始以政策原因封禁 Replit 和 Vibecode 等氛围编程应用，尽管确实存在可辩护的合理问题，但显然传统的应用分发范式在 2026 年正在彻底崩塌。我们在 1 月份宣布"垃圾内容之战"（War on Slop）是 2026 年的关键主题，而这张图现在是世界上最重要的图表之一，有助于思考它对 Apple App Store 数十年霸主地位以及其他类似软件分发平台相对于开放网络的影响。

AI Twitter Recap

Agent Infrastructure, Computer Use, and Design-to-Action Tooling

Anthropic's agent harness and "computer use" shift the product surface: A recurring theme today was that agent capability is increasingly about the harness, not just the base model. Anthropic published a new engineering writeup on how it uses a multi-agent harness for frontend design and long-running software tasks, emphasizing orchestration over one-shot prompting (AnthropicAI). Multiple developers independently argued that "computer use" matters because it lets models act in messy software environments with no reliable APIs (glennko), though others noted this is still slow and likely transitional until more tools expose APIs/CLI surfaces (Yuchenj_UW). The broader operational takeaway was captured well by kerrsee: retries, rollbacks, webhooks, structured logging, and recovery paths remain the unglamorous bottlenecks in production agent deployment.

Anthropic 的智能体调度框架（agent harness）和"计算机使用"（computer use）能力正在改变产品形态：今天反复出现的一个主题是，智能体的能力越来越取决于调度框架（harness），而不仅仅是基础模型。Anthropic 发布了一篇新的工程文章，介绍其如何使用多智能体调度框架进行前端设计和长时间运行的软件任务，强调编排（orchestration）而非一次性提示（one-shot prompting）。多位开发者独立指出，"计算机使用"很重要，因为它让模型能够在没有可靠 API 的混乱软件环境中运行，尽管也有人指出这仍然很慢，可能只是过渡方案，直到更多工具暴露 API/CLI 接口。kerrsee 很好地总结了更广泛的运营启示：重试、回滚、Webhook、结构化日志记录和恢复路径仍然是生产环境中智能体部署的"不 glamorous 的瓶颈"。

Figma/MCP/Cursor make design canvases directly agent-editable: The strongest concrete workflow launch was Figma's MCP server and direct AI editing on the canvas, now in open beta (figma). GitHub highlighted that this works through Copilot CLI and other clients via MCP (github), and Cursor immediately extended the pattern to generating components/frontends in Figma using a team's design system (cursor_ai). This is one of the clearest examples of tool-calling becoming product-native rather than chat-wrapper-native. LangChain also pushed in the same direction with framework-native tool rendering and Slack-native Fleet workflows, including custom Slack bots and an Inbox for human approvals (LangChain_JS, LangChain, hwchase17).

Figma/MCP/Cursor 让设计画布可直接被智能体编辑：最具体的工作流发布是 Figma 的 MCP 服务器（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）及其画布上的直接 AI 编辑功能，现已开放测试。GitHub 强调这通过 Copilot CLI 和其他 MCP 客户端工作，Cursor 立即扩展了这一模式，用于使用团队设计系统在 Figma 中生成组件/前端。这是工具调用成为产品原生功能而非聊天包装器原生功能的最清晰例子之一。LangChain 也朝着同一方向推进，推出框架原生工具渲染和 Slack 原生 Fleet 工作流，包括自定义 Slack 机器人和用于人工审批的收件箱。

Open Agent Platforms, Benchmarks, and RL Environment Stacks

Hermes Agent v0.4.0 is becoming a full personal-agent runtime: Nous released a substantial Hermes Agent v0.4.0 update with roughly 300 merged PRs in a week, adding an OpenAI-compatible Responses API backend, background self-improvement loops, broader messaging integrations, improved context compression, and more CLI ergonomics (Teknium, Teknium, NousResearch). The most technically interesting feature is the post-response review agent that decides what to retain as reusable memory/skills (Teknium). Community reactions focused less on benchmark claims and more on operational value: exposing a personal coding/ops agent behind a standard API makes it usable from Open WebUI, LobeChat, or any OpenAI-compatible client (witcheer).

Hermes Agent v0.4.0 正成为完整的个人智能体运行时：Nous 发布了重要的 Hermes Agent v0.4.0 更新，一周内合并了约 300 个 PR，增加了 OpenAI 兼容的 Responses API 后端、后台自我改进循环、更广泛的消息集成、改进的上下文压缩和更好的 CLI 人机工程学。技术上最有趣的特性是响应后审查智能体（post-response review agent），它决定保留哪些内容作为可复用的记忆/技能。社区反应较少关注基准测试声明，更多关注运营价值：将个人编码/运维智能体暴露在标准 API 后，使其可用于 Open WebUI、LobeChat 或任何 OpenAI 兼容客户端。

Open agent ecosystems are converging around environments, skills, and reproducible evals: AI2 released MolmoWeb, an open-source browser agent built on Molmo 2 in 4B and 8B sizes, claiming open-weight SOTA across four web-agent benchmarks and even surpassing some proprietary agents (allen_ai). In parallel, GenReasoning launched OpenReward, a platform exposing 330+ RL environments, autoscaled environment compute, and 4.5M+ unique RL tasks through one API—explicitly targeting the often-missing "environment compute" layer of agentic RL (GenReasoning, rosstaylor90). Zhipu contributed ZClawBench, a benchmark with 116 real-world agent tasks spanning office automation, coding, and analysis (HuggingPapers). Together, these point to a stack maturing from "agent demos" toward standardized environment serving + benchmarkable task suites + reusable harnesses.

开放智能体生态系统正围绕环境、技能和可复现评估收敛：AI2 发布了 MolmoWeb，一个基于 Molmo 2（4B 和 8B 参数）的开源浏览器智能体，声称在四个网页智能体基准测试中达到开源权重 SOTA，甚至超越了一些专有智能体。与此同时，GenReasoning 推出了 OpenReward 平台，通过单一 API 暴露 330+ 个 RL 环境、自动扩展的环境计算和 450 万+ 独特 RL 任务——明确针对智能体 RL 中常常缺失的"环境计算"层。智谱（Zhipu）贡献了 ZClawBench 基准测试，包含 116 个真实世界智能体任务，涵盖办公自动化、编码和分析。这些共同表明，技术栈正从"智能体演示"成熟为标准化环境服务 + 可基准测试任务套件 + 可复用调度框架。

Inference, Storage, and Systems Optimizations

vLLM and Transformers both reported material inference/runtime gains: vLLM's GTC recap highlighted several systems upgrades: Model Runner V2 with GPU-native Triton kernels, a hybrid memory allocator, encoder prefill disaggregation with up to 2.5x P99 throughput gains for multimodal workloads, and modular MoE kernels (vllm_project, vllm_project). Separately, Hugging Face/Transformers-side optimization work claimed continuous batching plus torch.compile tuning now reaches 95% of vLLM throughput for 8K generation, effectively closing the previous gap for synthetic data generation workloads (remi_or_).

vLLM 和 Transformers 都报告了实质性的推理/运行时性能提升：vLLM 的 GTC 回顾强调了多项系统升级：支持 GPU 原生 Triton 内核的 Model Runner V2、混合内存分配器、编码器预填充解聚（可实现多模态工作负载高达 2.5 倍 P99 吞吐提升）以及模块化 MoE 内核。另一方面，Hugging Face/Transformers 端的优化工作声称，连续批处理加上 torch.compile 调优现在可达到 vLLM 在 8K 生成场景下 95% 的吞吐，有效缩小了之前合成数据生成工作负载的性能差距。

hf-mount is a notable agent/data primitive: Hugging Face released hf-mount, which lets users mount Hub datasets, models, and storage buckets as a local filesystem, including examples with a 5TB FineWeb slice (julien_c, ClementDelangue). This matters beyond convenience: several engineers pointed out that agents are unusually good at filesystem operations, making mounted remote storage a natural substrate for agent memory, scratchpads, team artifact storage, and lazy access to large corpora (Vtrivedy10, victormustar). This is one of the more practical infrastructure launches of the day because it reduces the friction between local tooling and cloud-scale data.

hf-mount 是一个值得注意的智能体/数据原语：Hugging Face 发布了 hf-mount，允许用户将 Hub 数据集、模型和存储桶挂载为本地文件系统，包括挂载 5TB FineWeb 切片的示例。这不仅仅是方便：多位工程师指出，智能体特别擅长文件系统操作，使挂载的远程存储成为智能体记忆、草稿本、团队工件存储和延迟访问大型语料库的自然基础。这是当天更实用的基础设施发布之一，因为它减少了本地工具与云规模数据之间的摩擦。

Moreau and TurboQuant show optimization pressure moving below the model layer: Optimal Intellect introduced Moreau, a GPU-native solver from the CVXPY team claiming orders-of-magnitude speedups over existing tools (opt_intellect). Google Research announced TurboQuant, a KV-cache compression algorithm reporting at least 6x memory reduction and up to 8x speedup with no accuracy loss (GoogleResearch). The common pattern: high-value gains are increasingly coming from runtime, memory, and systems layers, not just from larger model checkpoints.

Moreau 和 TurboQuant 表明优化压力正转移到模型层之下：Optimal Intellect 推出了 Moreau，这是一个来自 CVXPY 团队的GPU 原生求解器，声称比现有工具快数个数量级。Google Research 宣布了 TurboQuant，一种 KV 缓存压缩算法，报告至少 6 倍内存减少和高达 8 倍加速且没有精度损失。共同模式是：高价值收益越来越来自运行时、内存和系统层，而不仅仅来自更大的模型检查点。

Security, Supply Chain Risk, and Guardrails for Agentic Software

The LiteLLM PyPI compromise dominated infra/security discussion: Multiple posts warned that LiteLLM 1.82.8 on PyPI had been compromised, with malicious payloads attempting to exfiltrate credentials and replicate across environments (hnykda). simonw noted the package was later quarantined on PyPI, but the incident quickly became a broader conversation about software supply-chain fragility. karpathy gave the most detailed summary, listing possible exfiltration targets including cloud creds, SSH keys, Kubernetes configs, CI/CD secrets, wallets, and shell history, while noting transitive risk to packages like DSPy. The most important systems-level implication came from DrJimFan: in an agentic world, the entire filesystem becomes part of the attack surface, since any file likely to enter context can become a vector.

LiteLLM 的 PyPI 供应链攻击主导了基础设施/安全讨论：多篇文章警告 PyPI 上的 LiteLLM 1.82.8 已被入侵，恶意载荷试图窃取凭证并在环境中复制。simonw 指出该包后来在 PyPI 上被隔离，但这一事件迅速演变为关于软件供应链脆弱性的更广泛讨论。karpathy 给出了最详细的总结，列出了可能的窃取目标，包括云凭证、SSH 密钥、Kubernetes 配置、CI/CD 密钥、钱包和 shell 历史记录，同时指出对 DSPy 等包的传递性风险。最重要的系统级启示来自 DrJimFan：在智能体世界中，整个文件系统都成为攻击面的一部分，因为任何可能进入上下文的文件都可能成为攻击向量。

"De-vibing" and permissioning are becoming first-class product requirements: Several posts effectively converged on a new design principle: autonomous coding tools need stronger shells, better permission defaults, and fewer broad dependencies. Yuchen called the incident "nightmare fuel" for --dangerously-skip-permissions style workflows (Yuchenj_UW); Anthropic's new Claude Code auto mode became controversial for exactly this reason, despite enthusiasm over the productivity jump (alexalbert__, kimmonismus). The practical response from many builders was a renewed preference for minimal bespoke routing, tighter audited deps, and stronger human approval loops.

"去氛围化"（De-vibing）和权限管理正成为一级产品需求：多篇帖子有效地汇聚到一个新的设计原则：自主编码工具需要更强的 shell 隔离、更好的权限默认值和更少的广泛依赖。Yuchen 称这一事件是 --dangerously-skip-permissions 风格工作流的"噩梦燃料"；Anthropic 的新 Claude Code 自动模式正因此引发争议，尽管人们对生产力提升充满热情。许多开发者的实际回应是重新偏好最小化定制路由、更严格的审计依赖和更强的人工审批循环。

Labs, Org Moves, and Product Strategy Shifts

AI2 loses leadership to Microsoft; Microsoft AI continues talent concentration: The clearest org move was the reaction to Microsoft poaching part of the AI2 leadership team, including mentions of Ali Farhadi, Hanna Hajishirzi, and Ranjay Krishna joining Microsoft Superintelligence (eliebakouch, NandoDF). The subtext in technical circles was concern over whether open research institutions can continue competing with hyperscalers for top talent and frontier-scale work (stanfordnlp).

AI2 领导层流失至 Microsoft；Microsoft AI 继续人才集中：最明显的组织变动是 Microsoft 挖走 AI2 领导团队部分成员的反应，包括 Ali Farhadi、Hanna Hajishirzi 和 Ranjay Krishna 加入 Microsoft Superintelligence（微软超级智能部门）。技术圈的潜台词是担忧开放研究机构是否还能继续与超大规模云服务商（hyperscalers）竞争顶尖人才和前沿规模的工作。

OpenAI is reallocating resources hard: $1B Foundation spend, Sora wind-down, "Spud" coming: OpenAI announced its Foundation will spend at least $1B over the next year, with Wojciech Zaremba moving to lead AI resilience and additional hires across disease, civil society, and operations (sama, woj_zaremba, btaylor). At the same time, reports circulated that OpenAI had finished initial development of its next major LLM, codenamed "Spud," and was winding down Sora's app/product footprint to free compute (steph_palazzolo, kimmonismus). For engineers, the signal is straightforward: OpenAI appears to be narrowing product focus around core general models/infrastructure, even at the cost of cutting side products.

OpenAI 正在大力重新分配资源：10 亿美元基金会支出、Sora 关停、"Spud" 即将推出：OpenAI 宣布其基金会将在明年至少投入 10 亿美元，Wojciech Zaremba 将转岗领导 AI 韧性（AI resilience）团队，并在疾病、公民社会和运营领域增加招聘。与此同时，有报道称 OpenAI 已完成其下一个主要 LLM 的初步开发，代号 "Spud"，并正在缩减 Sora 的应用/产品规模以释放计算资源。对工程师而言，信号很明确：OpenAI 似乎正在将产品重点缩小到核心通用模型/基础设施，即使以削减副业产品为代价。

Top tweets (by engagement)

- LiteLLM supply-chain compromise: karpathy gave the most technically complete and highest-signal breakdown of the PyPI attack and its blast radius.

- LiteLLM 供应链入侵：karpathy 对 PyPI 攻击及其影响范围给出了技术上最完整、信噪比最高的分析。

- Anthropic's harness engineering post: AnthropicAI was one of the day's most important engineering reads on how frontier labs are actually structuring long-running agent workflows.

- Anthropic 的调度框架工程文章：AnthropicAI 是当天最重要的工程阅读材料之一，讲述前沿实验室如何实际构建长时间运行的智能体工作流。

- Figma MCP launch: figma and github showed perhaps the cleanest mainstream example yet of agents acting directly on a production design surface.

- Figma MCP 发布：figma 和 github 展示了智能体直接作用于生产设计界面的最简洁主流示例。

- OpenAI Foundation $1B commitment: sama and woj_zaremba marked a major organizational and safety/resilience shift.

- OpenAI 基金会 10 亿美元承诺：sama 和 woj_zaremba 标志着重大的组织和安全/韧性转变。

- Hermes Agent v0.4.0: Teknium/NousResearch stood out as one of the biggest open-agent runtime releases of the day.

- Hermes Agent v0.4.0：Teknium/NousResearch 是当天最重大的开放智能体运行时发布之一。

AI Reddit Recap

/r/LocalLlama + /r/localLLM Recap

1. Security and Malware Concerns in AI Tools

LM Studio may possibly be infected with sophisticated malware. (Activity: 1822): The image in the Reddit post shows a Windows Security alert indicating that a severe threat, identified as "Trojan:JS/GlassWorm.ZZ!MTB," was quarantined from the LM Studio directory. This raised concerns about a potential malware infection in LM Studio. However, LM Studio and Microsoft have since confirmed that this was a false positive, likely due to Defender's heuristic definitions conflicting with LM Studio's obfuscated Electron bundle. The community discussion highlights the importance of security audits and the potential risks of obfuscation techniques that resemble malware patterns. Despite the false alarm, users are advised to take precautionary measures to secure their data.

LM Studio 可能感染了复杂的恶意软件。（活跃度：1822）：Reddit 帖子中的图片显示 Windows 安全警报，指出从 LM Studio 目录中隔离了一个名为"Trojan:JS/GlassWorm.ZZ!MTB"的严重威胁。这引发了对 LM Studio 潜在恶意软件感染的担忧。然而，LM Studio 和 Microsoft 此后确认这是误报，可能是由于 Defender 的启发式定义与 LM Studio 混淆的 Electron 包冲突所致。社区讨论强调了安全审计的重要性以及类似恶意软件模式的混淆技术的潜在风险。尽管是虚惊一场，仍建议用户采取预防措施保护数据。

Yags from LM Studio confirmed that the malware alert was a false positive, verified by Microsoft, and no longer appears in VirusTotal. Despite this, LM Studio is auditing their build machine scripts and environments to prevent any genuine security incidents in the future.

来自 LM Studio 的 Yags 确认恶意软件警报是误报，已得到 Microsoft 验证，且不再出现在 VirusTotal 中。尽管如此，LM Studio 正在审计其构建机器脚本和环境，以防止未来发生真正的安全事件。

Denoflore_ai_guy provided a detailed analysis suggesting the malware alert was likely a false positive due to Defender's heuristic updates conflicting with LM Studio's obfuscated Electron bundle. However, they noted that LM Studio's code obfuscation for IP protection could resemble malware techniques, which complicates detection.

Denoflore_ai_guy 提供了详细分析，指出由于 Defender 的启发式更新与 LM Studio 混淆的 Electron 包冲突，恶意软件警报很可能是误报。然而，他们指出 LM Studio 用于 IP 保护的代码混淆可能类似于恶意软件技术，这使检测变得复杂。

Denoflore_ai_guy also outlined steps to mitigate potential risks if GlassWorm malware was indeed present, including changing passwords, moving crypto funds, and checking for malicious Chrome extensions. They emphasized the importance of a clean OS install and credential rotation to ensure security.

Denoflore_ai_guy 还概述了如果确实存在 GlassWorm 恶意软件时的缓解措施，包括更改密码、转移加密资金和检查恶意 Chrome 扩展。他们强调了干净的操作系统安装和凭证轮换对确保安全的重要性。

[Developing situation] LiteLLM compromised (Activity: 380): The LiteLLM library has been compromised, as detailed in GitHub issue #24512. The attack exploits a .pth file vulnerability, which executes code on interpreter startup without requiring imports, making it difficult to detect through standard code reviews. Users of version 1.82.8 are advised to rotate credentials immediately if used in production environments, as the compromise could expose sensitive information.

[事态发展中] LiteLLM 被入侵（活跃度：380）：LiteLLM 库已被入侵，详见 GitHub issue #24512。该攻击利用了 .pth 文件漏洞，可在解释器启动时执行代码而无需导入，这使得通过标准代码审查难以检测。如果使用版本 1.82.8 且用于生产环境，建议用户立即轮换凭证，因为入侵可能暴露敏感信息。

The .pth file trick is highlighted as a significant security vulnerability. This method allows code execution on interpreter startup without needing imports, making it nearly invisible to standard code reviews. Users who ran LiteLLM versions 1.82.8 or 1.82.7 are advised to rotate credentials immediately due to potential exposure.

.pth 文件技巧被强调为重大安全漏洞。这种方法允许在解释器启动时执行代码而无需导入，使其对标准代码审查几乎不可见。建议运行 LiteLLM 版本 1.82.8 或 1.82.7 的用户因潜在暴露风险立即轮换凭证。

Aider, a tool that uses LiteLLM for LLM access, is reportedly safe as it operates on an older version (1.82.3) of LiteLLM, which is not compromised. The compromised versions are identified as 1.82.8 and 1.82.7, emphasizing the importance of version control and monitoring for security vulnerabilities.

据报道，Aider（一个使用 LiteLLM 进行 LLM 访问的工具）是安全的，因为它运行的是 LiteLLM 的旧版本（1.82.3），该版本未被入侵。被入侵的版本确认为 1.82.8 和 1.82.7，这强调了版本控制和对安全漏洞监控的重要性。

The discussion touches on the use of Docker containers for security isolation. While typically not considered a security measure, in this case, Docker effectively isolated host secrets, demonstrating its potential utility in mitigating certain types of security breaches.

讨论涉及使用 Docker 容器进行安全隔离。虽然通常不被视为安全措施，但在这种情况下，Docker 有效隔离了主机密钥，展示了其在缓解某些类型安全漏洞方面的潜在效用。

Litellm 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI are compromised, do not update! (Activity: 441): Litellm versions 1.82.7 and 1.82.8 on PyPI have been compromised, as confirmed by a blog post. The attack appears to be a supply chain compromise, potentially affecting thousands of users. The malicious versions were uploaded to PyPI, posing a significant risk to CI/CD pipelines that automatically update dependencies. The attack was executed through the GitHub account of the LiteLLM CEO, which was hacked, as evidenced by unauthorized commits and repository updates claiming 'teampcp owns BerriAI'.

PyPI 上的 Litellm 1.82.7 和 1.82.8 已被入侵，请勿更新！（活跃度：441）：已确认 PyPI 上的 Litellm 版本 1.82.7 和 1.82.8 已被入侵。这次攻击似乎是供应链入侵，可能影响数千用户。恶意版本被上传到 PyPI，对自动更新依赖的 CI/CD 管道构成重大风险。攻击是通过 LiteLLM CEO 的 GitHub 账户执行的，该账户被黑客入侵，证据是未经授权的提交和声称"teampcp 拥有 BerriAI"的仓库更新。

摘要: Claude Code推出Auto Mode新功能，允许AI代理在Claude Sonnet 4.6分类器的监督下自动进行权限决策，但作者质疑这种基于大模型的非确定性防护机制存在局限，指出其难以有效防范提示注入和供应链攻击，主张应采用确定性的沙盒环境作为更可靠的替代方案。

原标题: Auto mode for Claude Code

I remain unconvinced by prompt injection protections that rely on AI, since they're non-deterministic by nature. The documentation does warn that this may still let things through:

我仍然对依赖 AI 的提示注入（prompt injection）防护措施持怀疑态度，因为它们本质上是非确定性的。文档确实警告说，这仍可能让某些操作通过：

该分类器仍可能允许某些风险操作：例如，如果用户意图不明确，或者 Claude 没有足够的环境上下文来判断某项操作可能产生额外风险。

The classifier may still allow some risky actions: for example, if user intent is ambiguous, or if Claude doesn't have enough context about your environment to know an action might create additional risk.

该分类器仍可能允许某些风险操作：例如，如果用户意图不明确，或者 Claude 没有足够的环境上下文来判断某项操作可能产生额外风险。

The fact that the default allow list includespip install -r requirements.txtalso means that this wouldn't protect against supply chain attacks with unpinned dependencies, as seen this morningwith LiteLLM.

默认允许列表包含 pip install -r requirements.txt 这一事实也意味着，它无法防范使用未固定版本依赖项（unpinned dependencies）的供应链攻击（supply chain attacks），就像今天早上在 LiteLLM 上看到的那样。

I still want my coding agents to run in a robust sandbox by default, one that restricts file access and network connections in a deterministic way. I trust those a whole lot more than prompt-based protections like this new auto mode.

我仍然希望我的编码代理（coding agents）默认在一个强健的沙盒（sandbox）中运行，以确定性方式限制文件访问和网络连接。比起这种新的自动模式等基于提示的防护措施，我更信任那些机制。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: 慢下来的思考
item.description:
标签: #AI编程 #认知债务 #代码质量 #开发速度

摘要: 本文批评了滥用AI编码代理追求速度而牺牲代码质量的现象，警示微小错误会指数级累积形成难以维护的复杂系统。作者呼吁开发者放慢节奏，限制AI代码生成量并手工编写核心架构，以在编码效率与认知严谨性之间重建平衡。

原标题: Thoughts on slowing the fuck down

Thoughts on slowing the fuck down

关于放慢脚步的思考

We have basically given up all discipline and agency for a sort of addiction, where your highest goal is to produce the largest amount of code in the shortest amount of time. Consequences be damned.

我们基本上已经放弃了所有的纪律（discipline）和能动性（agency），陷入了一种成瘾状态，你的最高目标是在最短的时间内产出最大量的代码。后果去他妈的。

We have basically given up all discipline and agency for a sort of addiction, where your highest goal is to produce the largest amount of code in the shortest amount of time. Consequences be damned.

我们基本上已经放弃了所有的纪律（discipline）和能动性（agency），陷入了一种成瘾状态，你的最高目标是在最短的时间内产出最大量的代码。后果去他妈的。

Agents and humans both make mistakes, but agent mistakes accumulate much faster:

AI Agent（智能体）和人类都会犯错，但 Agent 的错误累积（mistakes accumulate）速度要快得多：

A human is a bottleneck. A human cannot shit out 20,000 lines of code in a few hours. Even if the human creates such booboos at high frequency, there's only so many booboos the human can introduce in a codebase per day. [...]

人类是一个瓶颈（bottleneck）。人类不可能在几小时内就粗制滥造出 20,000 行代码。即使人类以高频率制造这种小错误（booboos），他每天能引入代码库的错误数量也是有限的。[...]

With an orchestrated army of agents, there is no bottleneck, no human pain. These tiny little harmless booboos suddenly compound at a rate that's unsustainable. You have removed yourself from the loop, so you don't even know that all the innocent booboos have formed a monster of a codebase. You only feel the pain when it's too late. [...]

有了协调一致的 Agent 军队，就没有瓶颈，也没有人类的痛苦。这些看似无害的小错误突然以不可持续的速度复利增长（compound）。你已经把自己从反馈循环（the loop）中移除，所以你甚至不知道所有这些无辜的小错误已经形成了一个代码库怪物。只有当为时已晚时，你才会感受到痛苦。[...]

You have zero fucking idea what's going on because you delegated all your agency to your agents. You let them run free, and they are merchants of complexity.

你他妈完全不知道发生了什么，因为你把所有的能动性（agency）都委托给了你的 Agent。你让它们自由运行，而它们是复杂性的商人（merchants of complexity）。

A human is a bottleneck. A human cannot shit out 20,000 lines of code in a few hours. Even if the human creates such booboos at high frequency, there's only so many booboos the human can introduce in a codebase per day. [...]

人类是一个瓶颈（bottleneck）。人类不可能在几小时内就粗制滥造出 20,000 行代码。即使人类以高频率制造这种小错误（booboos），他每天能引入代码库的错误数量也是有限的。[...]

I think Mario is exactly right about this. Agents let us move so much faster, but this speed also means that changes which we would normally have considered over the course of weeks are landing in a matter of hours.

我认为Mario（马里奥）说得完全正确。Agent 让我们行动得更快，但这种速度也意味着我们通常需要数周时间考虑的变化，现在在几小时内就完成了。

It's so easy to let the codebase evolve outside of our abilities to reason clearly about it. Cognitive debt is real.

我们很容易让代码库的发展超出我们清晰推理（reason）的能力范围。认知债务（Cognitive debt）是真实存在的。

Mario recommends slowing down:

Mario（马里奥）建议放慢速度：

Give yourself time to think about what you're actually building and why. Give yourself an opportunity to say, fuck no, we don't need this. Set yourself limits on how much code you let the clanker generate per day, in line with your ability to actually review the code. [...]

给自己时间去思考你真正在构建什么以及为什么。给自己一个机会说，去他妈的，我们不需要这个。根据你实际审查代码的能力，为每天允许clanker（指 AI 生成工具）生成的代码量设定限制。[...]

Anything that defines the gestalt of your system, that is architecture, API, and so on, write it by hand. [...]

任何定义系统整体形态（gestalt）的东西，也就是架构（architecture）、API 等等，都要手写。[...]

Give yourself time to think about what you're actually building and why. Give yourself an opportunity to say, fuck no, we don't need this. Set yourself limits on how much code you let the clanker generate per day, in line with your ability to actually review the code.

给自己时间去思考你真正在构建什么以及为什么。给自己一个机会说，去他妈的，我们不需要这个。根据你实际审查代码的能力，为每天允许 clanker（AI 生成工具）生成的代码量设定限制。

Anything that defines the gestalt of your system, that is architecture, API, and so on, write it by hand. [...]

任何定义系统整体形态（gestalt）的东西，也就是架构（architecture）、API 等等，都要手写。[...]

I'm not convinced writing by hand is the best way to address this, but it's absolutely the case that we need the discipline to find a new balance of speed v.s. mental thoroughness now that typing out the code is no longer anywhere close to being the bottleneck on writing software.
